title: 12 years, same sacrifice: BMX racer Daniel Caluag chases another Asiad gold
summary: Twelve years ago, BMX racer Daniel Caluag had to leave the day after the birth of his daughter Sydney to compete at the 2014 Asian Games in Incheon, South Korea.
